success.description: Your song swells and ripples through the mists of the Cursed Marshes like a living thing, calling the Winds of Magic to you. Gain 1 power.

bane.description: Suffer 1 stress. If, after resolving this action you have more power than twice your WP, suffer 1 additional stress.
